[quote=bantarus;59948742][i]By order of the Allthing and with the full authority of His Majesty the High King, the Second Commonwealth of Jomsland hereby announces the deployment of ships and soldiers to Nestorstaat, in direct support of our shieldbrother, the Technocratic Kaiserreich.
Effective immediately, the 6th and 8th Fleets of the Jomslandic Coastguard have been dispatched to the waters surrounding the island of Nestorstaat. Each fleet comprises:

2 Brimbrjótur-Class Heavy Destroyers

1 Rakvélklærnar-Class Guided Missile Cruiser

Several Viking-Class Long-Range Supply Vessels

This will ensure both strategic projection and continuous logistical sustainment.
To further reinforce the stability of our ally, the following land and air assets are being mobilized:

5,000 Warriors of the Jomsviking Order

20,000 Troops of the Jomslandic Sea Battalion

2,500 Úlfhéðnar Special Forces

The Jomslandic Aircraft Carrier SHH Heimaeyja, accompanied by its air wing.[/i]

[nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation]
[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
[nation]BR Bob[/nation]
[nation]Sikirsk[/nation][/quote]

Hydronian and Jomslandic ships now sit face-to-face around the Nestor-Sikirskian island. A transmission is made to the Jomslandic fleet,

[i][b]This is admiral Karaman speaking. We order you to turn around and leave this area immediately or face the might of THEP. We are under orders to not allow any ships into this island until it falls back under Sikirskian control and we will use any force necessary to comply with these orders, so I suggest you sail back home to Jomsland and nobody gets hurt.[/b][/i]

At the same time, the Hydronian ministry of war and defence telegrams an ultimatum to the TK.

[i][b]To the Government of the Technokratisches Kaiserreich,

Hydronia, in the interest of maintaining regional stability and respecting the sovereignty of Sikirsk, hereby issues a formal and unequivocal ultimatum regarding the military presence on the Nestor-Sikirskian island.

Effective immediately, the following demands must be met:

1. Complete and unconditional withdrawal of all military forces of the Technokratisches Kaiserreich from Nestor-Sikirskian territorial waters and the island itself.
 
2. Handing over control of Nestor-Sikirsk back to the sovereign government of Sikirsk, restoring its territorial integrity and sovereignty without delay.

Failure to comply with these demands within 72 hours from the receipt of this ultimatum will compel Hydronia to initiate military action to liberate and secure the island, in cooperation with our allies in THEP.

Be advised that any attempt to resist or delay will be met with overwhelming force. Our military forces are positioned and prepared to enforce this ultimatum, and we will not hesitate to use all necessary means to uphold international law and regional stability.

This is the final warning. The choice rests with the Technokratisches Kaiserreich.
  
Hydronian Ministry of War and Defence  
18/7/2025[/b][/i]

*In an international radio broadcast, the following message is sent out to the warring countries.*

Citizens and refugees of these great nations, Enkia offers full sanctuary to you. Our borders are open, medical staff and housing units stand at the ready to recieve all who need it. Should you choose to, Enkia will make grand efforts to return you, safely, to your home and are more than happy to accept those who choose to stay as Citizens. Our country was forged in a wr born of oppression, we know what it's like to be ripped from your home, and to see your family separated.
You will not suffer alone. Come to us, heal, and grieve.
No military personnel of any country will be given this aid however. We remain nuetral, and seek only to provide a safe haven for the people who did not choose this war. Individual soldiers may dump arms at the border and recieve medical aid, but must swiftly return to the border, and may enter only under EAF escort, please only use this in truly desperate situations so as to not cause the citizens panic at possibly having an enemy soldier among them.
Astarte Airport remains at stand by ready to begin expediting citizens to their homelands at their behest, any countries that wish to aid in this effort please send supplies and workers to that air port.
Ave Satanas, Stay Safe my friends.
*The radio broadcast loops to a version in another language. To the High Priest's credit it seems he took the time to learn the speech in multiple languages, even if his Enkian accent bleeds through in allot of them.*
